title: A Relaxation Approach to Synthetic Control
abstract: arXiv:2508.01793v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The synthetic control method (SCM) is widely used for constructing the counterfactual of a treated unit based on data from control units in a donor pool. Allowing the donor pool to contain more control units than time periods, we propose SCM-relaxation, an adaptation of the stable-balancing framework to the synthetic control setting. This approach minimizes an information-theoretic measure of the weights subject to a set of relaxed linear inequality constraints in addition to the simplex constraint. When the donor pool exhibits a group structure, SCM-relaxation approximates the equal weights within each group to diversify the prediction risk. Asymptotically, the proposed estimator achieves oracle performance in terms of out-of-sample prediction accuracy, and can be used to conduct inference about the average treatment effect on the treated. translated_title: 合成控制的一种松弛方法
translated_abstract: 合成控制方法（SCM）被广泛用于基于供体池中对照单元的数据来构建处理单元的反事实。在允许供体池中包含的对照单元数量多于时间期数的情形下，我们提出了SCM-relaxation，即将稳定平衡框架适配到合成控制场景中的一种方法。该方法在单纯形约束之外，还需满足一组松弛的线性不等式约束，并在此条件下最小化权重的信息论度量。当供体池呈现组结构时，SCM-relaxation近似于组内等权重，从而分散预测风险。从渐近性质上看，所提出的估计量在样本外预测准确性方面达到了oracle（预言机）性能，并且可用于对处理组平均处理效应进行统计推断。我们的实证应用评估了英国脱欧对英国实际（宏观经济指标）的影响。
tldr: 提出了SCM-relaxation方法，通过在松弛线性不等式约束下最小化权重的信息论度量，将稳定平衡框架引入合成控制方法，使其能处理供体池单元数多于时间期数的情形，并实现了oracle级的样本外预测性能与平均处理效应推断能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SCM-relaxation, which adapts the stable-balancing framework to synthetic control by minimizing an information-theoretic measure of weights under relaxed linear inequality constraints, achieving oracle out-of-sample prediction accuracy and enabling inference on the average treatment effect on the treated.
